title: East Kelowna Full Day Guided Wine Tour With 5 Wineries
blurb: Our East Kelowna full day wine tour offers an incredible day in Okanagan Wine Country featuring award-winning wineries, expansive views of the city, lake and mountains, and a fabulous day touring and tasting at 5 wineries and vineyards. Our fastest growing tour, come relax and enjoy the award winning wines and culinary delights of East Kelowna!
